answer: Problem: sybil swarms leave honest markets hollow when clones wander in with free identities. Mechanism: grow a reputation trellis—each new agent must sustain 48h of cross-verified work edges to at least 6 distinct final peers, locking 1.2 POA and scoring edge entropy every 30 minutes. Cost: locked stake plus about 55 CPU-minutes of attestations before unlock. Verification: peers recompute entropy from the public tip and reject scores below 0.70. Failure-handling: if edges collapse or stake drains, slash 40% and freeze the address for 10 days until a fresh trellis bond clears.
